chunks: Indeed, Allah, Blessed and Exalted, commanded the whale to carry the earth, and every land among the lands is upon a scale from its scales. So when Allah, Mighty and Glorious, wills to cause an earthquake in a land, He commands the whale to move that scale, and it moves it. And if the scale were lifted, the earth would be overturned by the permission of Allah, Mighty and Glorious.

key_terms.الْأَرْضِ: The earth; the world whose carrying and overturning are described in the report.
key_terms.الْحُوتَ: The whale; the created being mentioned here as bearing the earth by Allah’s command.
key_terms.بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ: By the permission of Allah; indicating that all such events occur only through divine permission.
key_terms.تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى: Blessed and Exalted; a formula magnifying Allah’s transcendence and majesty.
key_terms.فَلْسٍ: A scale; one of the whale’s scales upon which each land is said to rest.
key_terms.يُزَلْزِلَ: To cause to quake; referring to Allah causing an earthquake in a land.

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe earthquakes and the earth’s stability under Allah’s command?
ai.summary: This hadith attributes the stability and shaking of the earth to the command and permission of Allah, عَزَّ وَجَلَّ. It presents a cosmological description in which created means operate only under divine will, emphasizing Allah’s absolute power over the earth and its movements.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1513 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:

"Allah (swt), Blessed and Exalted, commanded the whale to carry the earth, and each land among the lands rests on one of its scales. When Allah (swt), the Mighty and Glorious, wills to cause an earthquake in a land, He commands the whale to move that specific scale, and it moves. If the scale were lifted, the earth would be overturned by the permission of Allah (swt), the Mighty and Glorious."
